$about: The stack registry - the ONLY source of official technology best practices (Layer 2). The align router reads this file from its checkout of the living standard (always latest, ADR-025); a stack not listed here is not official, wherever it lives. Discovery only by design: name, repo, one line - a stack's own stack.manifest.json carries the linkage (the registry back-pointer + technology) and the alignable entries; no version range anywhere - stacks are linked, not version-locked (ADR-022) - so core releases are never blocked on registry edits. Policy: one stack repo per technology, named for the technology inside the repository-standards organization (repository-standards/node, repository-standards/python); variation is a profile or an adoption mode inside the stack, never a sibling repo; an official stack keeps a named owner and a live boot CI or is delisted.

stacks.description: Node/TypeScript - Next.js + Fastify through one proxy, Better Auth, tiered testing; boot-verified starter
